mapper.select: select coalesce(mgm.billing_type, m.billing_type) as billingType, coalesce(mgm.prompt_price, m.prompt_price) as promptPrice, coalesce(mgm.cached_prompt_price, m.cached_prompt_price) as cachedPromptPrice, coalesce(mgm.cache_write_prompt_price, m.cache_write_prompt_price) as cacheWritePromptPrice, coalesce(mgm.completion_price, m.completion_price) as completionPrice, coalesce(mgm.request_price, m.request_price) as requestPrice, coalesce(mgm.multiplier, m.multiplier) as multiplier from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = #{groupId} and mgm.model_id = #{modelId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into model_group_models (group_id, model_id) values (#{groupId}, #{modelId})
